entities.summary: Lucas Christopher Duda is an American former professional baseball first baseman and outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) from 2010 to 2019 for the New York Mets, Tampa Bay Rays, Atlanta Braves, and Kansas City Royals. He was the starting first baseman for the 2015 Mets team that won the National League pennant, and led the team in games played during the 2010s.
